changes: Fixed LLVM spellings for hyphenated VM operations; no per-call character-list reconstruction.
Private dense-label bitmap with sparse-list fallback for ordered dispatch destinations; phi predecessors unchanged.
Direct immutable named-tuple collection preserving parser capture, descriptor-name timing, callback order, failure identity, and reentrancy.
Per-expansion import-loader timing counter; expand excludes import-parse; no timing work when disabled.
Runtime radix-prefix recognition discovered necessary during full compiler capability validation; borrowing, no string clone.
methodology: All reported latency runs sequential in fresh processes, with no overlapping test/build workloads.
Authoritative Chibi ablation copies each compiler variant to one common active source path. Input root is a separate frozen archive of baseline src/bootstrap/examples, held fixed across variants.
Five alternating parser pairs measure s-file on the same 16801-character base.sld, excluding startup/file read/grammar initialization; parser-time verifies host-reader agreement.

Three rotating full compiler samples for four variants use the normal compile.scm entry with --timing; wall time includes startup and LLVM file output, excludes Cargo. All twelve outputs have the same SHA256 and LLVM verification passed.
Stage medians need not add to median wall time. Baseline expand includes imported-source loading/parsing; final expand excludes invocation-local loader intervals before rounding.
Early emitter/parser prototypes use separate source paths and sometimes instrumented saved-VM input. Treat these as exploratory diagnostics rather than controlled attribution of final gains.
A contended exploratory parser batch and overlapping tail of phase-lifetime probes were excluded. Final ablations reran sequentially at a common active path.

First native batch rotates baseline/emitter-only/all-Scheme-changes executables for three samples, before the radix fix. Final native batch alternates baseline and final-runtime executables for three pairs; keep batches separate.

Native runs compile the same frozen Fibonacci source/library paths to LLVM and exclude building the compiler and any Cargo build of the emitted output. Baseline binary SHA matches the prior numeric-start report.
Full compiler-source runs under native/WASI and current-source native run are single capability checks, not before/after timing ablations. All match their corresponding Chibi output byte-for-byte.
WASI timings include Node startup. The compiler build remains Chibi hosted.

exploratory.limitations: Exploratory paths differ; no speedup claimed from lifetime probes. Numeric formatting improved isolated emission but regressed normal compilation. Chibi allocation/GC interaction not yet explained.

simplify.accepted: Keep semantic steps directly visible; fresh local ownership for timing/bitmap, no parser cache, exact failure propagation.
simplify.exceptions: Complete handler dispatch, destination traversal, expansion timing operation, and test scenarios can exceed ten logic lines when splitting scatters their invariants.
simplify.stopping_reason: Remaining code expresses tested ordering, identity and ownership contracts; additional scanner/output/lifetime changes did not justify added complexity.
